say:1:1130512001:1.text: A powerful sandstorm is blowing in from the Ashen Wastes.
say:1:1130512001:1.source_cn: 非常厉害的沙尘暴，会从荒角沙漠的方向被狂风吹过来。
say:1:1130512001:1.male: A powerful sandstorm is blowing in from the Ashen Wastes.
say:1:1130512001:1.female: A powerful sandstorm is blowing in from the Ashen Wastes.

say:2:1130512002:1.text: When one comes along you can't tell the sky from the dunes. You've got to see it to believe it.
say:2:1130512002:1.source_cn: 沙暴来时，就像头顶的天空与脚下的沙漠颠倒过来，只要你经...

say:2:1130512002:1.female: When one comes along you can't tell the sky from the dunes. You've got to see it to believe it.
